Glad you found it. I saved this in the project's shared memory: the invoice PDF tests fail on newer wkhtmltopdf versions unless you pass `--enable-local-file-access`. Future sessions and collaborators will see it if the PDF tests break again.

You said the fix is local only. If it's a flag in the render code, it'll take effect wherever you commit it. If it's in your local wkhtmltopdf config or a wrapper script, CI and other developers' machines could still hit the same failure.
